blocks.text: Watch a video on Endpoint Credential Exposure.

The Endpoint Credential Exposure dashboard summarizes the security posture of your endpoints. The dashboard provides visibility into exposed endpoint credentials. You can investigate risks and clean up the exposed credentials to protect the endpoints from external attack.
The Endpoint Credential Exposure dashboard provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Obtain visibility into credential exposure and vulnerabilities that exist on your endpoints.
Investigate the identities that are compromised.
View the domain risk severity and leverage the remediation reduction roadmap to lower the risk severity level.
View remediation guidance and clean up exposed credentials to make the endpoints less vulnerable to identity-based attacks.

blocks.heading: About the Endpoint Credential Exposure Dashboard

blocks.text: On the Endpoint Credential Exposure dashboard (ITDR > Dashboard > Endpoint Credential Exposure), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Download the endpoint executive report in the PDF.

Download the endpoint credential exposure scan data. A .zip file containing multiple CSV files is downloaded to your system. The CSV files for each exposure type contain the list of endpoints and the exposed credential details.
View the total number of endpoints assessed in your system.
View the total number of identities containing credential exposure issues.
View the severity of risk for the exposed credentials, categorized as Critical, High, Medium, or Low. The risk posture improves as the severity level decreases.

View the top 5 exposed credentials found on the endpoints. The findings help you prioritize and remediate the issues to reduce the risk severity. Click an exposed credential to view additional details.
View the top 10 identities that have credential exposure issues. Having visibility of these identities helps you to prioritize what to focus on first.
View all exposed credentials categorized by severity in a bar chart.
View all exposed credentials categorized by risk type (e.g., Browser Credentials, Windows Credentials, Privilege Escalation, etc.) in a donut chart, represented as percentages.
View the Risk Reduction Roadmap to see the current and target risk score and set targets to systematically lower the risk severity by providing a prioritized remediation road map.
